title: An Clinical Study of YTS109 Cell Injection in Subjects With Recurrent/Refractory Autoimmune Disease
off: An Exploratory Clinical Study of the Safety and Efficacy of YTS109 Cell Injection in Subjects With Recurrent/Refractory Autoimmune Disease
summary: An exploratory clinical study of the safety and efficacy of YTS109 cell injection in subjects with recurrent/refractory autoimmune disease
desc: This study is a prospective exploratory clinical trial in subjects with recurrent/refractory autoimmune disease. The objective is to evaluate the safety, initial efficacy and PK/PD characteristics of YTS109 cells in the treatment of recurrent/refractory autoimmune diseases.
